episodes.title: The Grand Opening

episodes.overview: When Rick and Marty finally get underground in the Garden Shaft for the first time this year, they may be foiled by an ancient booby trap.
episodes.title: The Great Flood

episodes.overview: When the team experiences a frustrating setback, they are stunned to learn it may have led to a breakthrough discovery.
episodes.title: A Void At All Costs

episodes.overview: While the team struggles to stop water from pouring into the Garden Shaft, the connection between Oak Island, Captain Phipps and The Knights Templar is rapidly intensifying on Lot 5.
episodes.title: Filling Cavities

episodes.overview: The Fellowship resumes their efforts in the swamp and are immediately rewarded with stunning evidence of large cargo being moved on Oak Island centuries ago.
episodes.title: Chain Reaction

episodes.overview: The Fellowship is ecstatic when they uncover another structure in the swamp. And in the Money Pit, evidence suggests they may have come into contact with the elusive Chappell Vault.
episodes.title: Plugged Up

episodes.overview: While the team continues to chase the elusive tunnel in the Money Pit, evidence that the swamp was used for an off-loading operation abounds, and new clues on Lot 5 point to Captain Phipps.
episodes.title: Digging Back In

episodes.overview: While Gary and Rick uncover unprecedented finds in the swamp, the team finally reaches depth in the Garden Shaft and their probe drilling operation delivers thrilling results immediately.
episodes.title: Tea Time

episodes.overview: With the help of science, the Fellowship uncovers an irrefutable connection between the Money Pit and Lot 5.
episodes.title: Rick And Mortar

episodes.overview: After months of hard work, the Laginas once again descend the Garden Shaft and finally hit the tunnel they've been chasing all year.
episodes.title: On Target

episodes.overview: While new discoveries across the island continue to invigorate the team, a dangerous storm threatens to shut down the entire operation.
episodes.title: Dark and Stormy

episodes.title: Piling On

episodes.title: May The Norse Be With You

episodes.overview: As the connection between Nolan's Cross and The Knights Templar deepens the team digs up treasure on Lot Five.
episodes.title: Hi Ho Silver

episodes.overview: The team has finally reached target depth in the Garden Shaft, but their drilling efforts may be thwarted by a legendary flood tunnel.
episodes.title: Wet and Wild

episodes.overview: The team is estatic when a recent theory about Nolan's cross comes to fruition while they prepare for a European adventure on the horizon.
episodes.title: Straight as an Arrow

episodes.overview: While the team discovers a surprising find on lot 5, members of the fellowship arrive in Europe and immediately discover more Templar connections .
episodes.title: Abbey Road

episodes.overview: While a trip to Europe continues to uncover clues connecting the Templars to Scandinavian culture and Oak Island, on Oak Island, a clue found beneath a Nolan's Cross boulder may offer answers the team has been desperate for.

episodes.overview: While a trip abroad makes old world connections to new world, on Oak Island, the team is thrilled when new evidence indicates that whoever was on Lot 5, was also deep in the Money Pit.
episodes.title: Hairy Situation

episodes.title: Worth The Weight

episodes.title: The New Digs

episodes.overview: The team is thrilled yet concerned when the investigation of the Golden Egg, an area that scientific evidence suggests the legendary riches are hidden, immediately shows signs that they've come upon an underground void that may be collapsing.
episodes.title: Whistle While You Work

episodes.overview: Marty and members of the team travel to the north to a Viking settlement and uncover more evidence that may connect descendants of the Vikings to the Knights Templar. Back on Oak Island, new clues suggest Lot 5 was a place of worship.
episodes.title: The Saga Continues

episodes.overview: As the team continues to uncover evidence that they may be close to the flood tunnels, cutting-edge, ground-penetrating radar results detect what could be the elusive offset chamber in the Money Pit.
episodes.title: A Flood of Secrets

episodes.overview: After more than a dozen years of searching, the team may have discovered the legendary Chappell Vault.

episodes.title: Caissons Ho!

episodes.title: Sinking In

episodes.overview: Spirits are high and the Fellowship is more hopeful than ever as the team digs into Aladdin's cave
episodes.title: Open Sesame

episodes.overview: As the Oak Island team digs a prime location in the Money Pit area, they unearth stunning clues that could identify just who was behind the 230-year-old treasure mystery
episodes.title: Boots on the Ground

episodes.title: If The Shoe Phips

episodes.overview: As new research identifies who may have been behind the Oak Island mystery, the Laginas and their team are stunned by what they find in the Money Pit area.
episodes.title: Just Bead It

episodes.title: The Solution Solution

episodes.overview: While the team races against the impending winter to get into the Solution Channel and finally retrieve the treasure on Oak Island, Rick and members of the fellowship make new connections 4,000 miles away in Malta.
episodes.title: Knight After Knight

episodes.overview: While the team races to prepare the Money Pit for the deepest, and final dig of the season, in Malta, the fellowship uncovers a family bloodline that connects the Knights of Malta to Oak Island.
episodes.title: Family Ties

episodes.overview: The team finally reaches the Solution Channel despite a terrifying collapse.
episodes.title: Into the Void

episodes.overview: As winter approaches, the Fellowship is racing against time as they're closer than ever to finding the one thing.
episodes.title: Uplifting Discoveries

episodes.title: The Comeback

episodes.overview: After the team makes an ancient discovery on Lot 5, they learn that the fabled treasure could be worth more than anyone imagined.
episodes.title: Billion Dollar Baby

episodes.overview: New discoveries in the Swamp and Money Pit area lead to a potentially history-changing revelation for the team.
episodes.title: Medieval Intentions

episodes.overview: As the team drills deeper than ever into the Money Pit area, a find in the swamp could have explosive implications.
episodes.title: The Smoking Gun

episodes.overview: As the team finds more traces of treasure in the Money Pit, they discover a clue that may guide them to the ultimate answers on Oak Island.
episodes.title: The Heat Is On

episodes.overview: While investigating a potentially ancient marker stone on Oak Island, the team makes stunning new discoveries.
episodes.title: Walk the Line

episodes.overview: After a new Bobby Dazzler is unearthed on Lot 5, the Oak Island team makes a discovery with possible religious implications.
episodes.title: Into the Fold

episodes.overview: After verifying a recent find on Lot 5 to be a sacred, religious artifact, the team drills through a surprising discovery deep in the Money Pit area.
episodes.title: So Close, Yet Sonar

episodes.overview: When the team finds an artifact on Lot 8 that may date to medieval times, it leads them to another, massive discovery.
episodes.title: Boulder and Wiser

episodes.overview: As the team makes a potentially key discovery beneath a boulder on Lot 8, new clues arise that could identify who was behind the Oak Island mystery.

episodes.overview: While the team investigates a Knight of Malta who may have visited Oak Island, they record video of possible treasure buried underground.

episodes.overview: After compelling new clues are discovered in the swamp and on Lot 8, the team finds an astonishing silver lining in the Money Pit.

episodes.title: The Shining

seasons.overview: Ambassador Kate Wyler lives the particular nightmare that is getting what you want. She just accused Vice President Grace Penn of hatching a terrorist plot and admitted she's after the VP's job. But now the President is dead, Kate's husband Hal may have inadvertently killed him, and Grace Penn is leader of the free world. None of this slows Hal's campaign to land Kate the vice presidency. Kate steps into a role she never wanted, with a freedom she never expected, an increasingly complicated friendship with Foreign Secretary Austin Dennison, and an unnerving bond with First Gentleman Todd Penn.

episodes.overview: In the outer solar system near Saturn, James Holden and the crew of the ice-freighter Canterbury, investigate a distress call from a mysterious derelict ship, the Scopuli. On Ceres Station, Detective Miller begins an off the book investigation of a missing heiress, Julie Mao.

episodes.overview: Holden and crew are trapped in badly damaged shuttle. On Ceres, Miller uncovers clues about Julie Mao. On Earth, Chrisjen Avasarala questions a terrorist.
episodes.title: The Big Empty

episodes.overview: Holden and the crew are taken prisoner by the Martian Congressional Republic Navy. Miller deals with unhappy rioters. Avasarala plays politics and gets severely burned.
episodes.title: Remember the Cant

episodes.overview: Holden and crew find themselves in the middle of a desperate battle while still aboard the Martian battleship. Miller’s partner, Havelock, goes missing.
episodes.title: CQB

episodes.overview: Holden finds an unlikely ally. Miller’s obsession with Mao intensifies.
episodes.title: Back to the Butcher

episodes.overview: Miller gains valuable information from a hidden data cube. Holden and his crew learn their host’s agenda.
episodes.title: Rock Bottom

episodes.title: Windmills

episodes.overview: A derelict vessel holds a potentially devastating secret. Holden and his crew cross paths with Miller on Eros. Avasarala receives bad news.
episodes.title: Salvage

episodes.overview: Julie's origin story ends up revealing her trajectory. Holden and Miller work together as they take a look at a strange emergency happening on Eros.
episodes.title: Critical Mass

episodes.overview: Avasarala uncovers a game-changing secret while the future of the human race might be in Holden and Miller's hands.
episodes.title: Leviathan Wakes

seasons.overview: In season one, the disappearance of rich-girl-turned-political-activist Julie Mao linked the lives of Ceres' detective Joe Miller, accidental ship captain James Holden and U.N. politician Chrisjen Avasarala. Amidst political tension between Earth, Mars and the Asteroid Belt, these three individuals unravel the single greatest conspiracy of all time.
seasons.title: Season 1

episodes.title: Safe

episodes.title: Static

episodes.overview: Miller devises a dangerous plan to eradicate what's left of the protomolecule on Eros.
episodes.title: Godspeed

episodes.overview: The Rocinante chases an asteroid as it hurtles towards Earth.
episodes.title: Home

episodes.overview: Earth and Mars search for answers in the aftermath of the asteroid collision.
episodes.title: Paradigm Shift

episodes.overview: Preparations for the Earth/Mars peace conference tighten the tension on Erringwright.
episodes.title: The Seventh Man

episodes.overview: Naomi tracks down signs of the protomolecule; Fred Johnson's control over the OPA collapses.
episodes.title: Pyre

episodes.overview: Bobbie becomes a political pawn in the struggle between Earth and Mars.
episodes.title: The Weeping Somnambulist

episodes.overview: Holden leads his crew through the war-torn station on Ganymede.
episodes.title: Cascade

episodes.overview: Bobbie makes a decision that changes her life forever.
episodes.title: Here There Be Dragons

episodes.overview: A discovery pushes Naomi and Holden apart and sets the Rocinante crew against each other.
episodes.title: The Monster and the Rocket

episodes.overview: The Rocinante crew must fight to save the ship.
episodes.title: Caliban's War

seasons.overview: Season 2 kicks off with interplanetary tensions at an all-time high, the cold war between Earth and Mars is on the brink of an all-out battle.
seasons.title: Season 2

episodes.overview: The Rocinante crew deals with the fallout over Naomi's betrayal while caught in the middle of the war between Earth and Mars. Meanwhile, Avasarala and Bobbie hatch an escape plan.
episodes.title: Fight or Flight

episodes.title: IFF

episodes.overview: As Earth strategizes a costly ploy to gain advantage in the war against Mars, Anna struggles to convince Sorrento-Gillis to do the right thing. Avasarala and Bobbie seek refuge aboard the Rocinante.
episodes.title: Assured Destruction

episodes.overview: The Rocinante tends to wounded Martian soldiers in exchange for supplies. Avasarala struggles with how to disseminate a key piece of evidence despite being in hiding.
episodes.title: Reload

episodes.overview: The search for Prax's daughter comes to a head. Admiral Souther's men plan for mutiny aboard the Agatha King
episodes.title: Triple Point

episodes.overview: The final battle between Earth and Mars threatens the very future of humanity. A new monster is unleashed on Prospero Station. Anna receives the smoking gun she needs.
episodes.title: Immolation

episodes.overview: All eyes turn to the edge of the solar system as a mysterious new presence emerges; Naomi recommits to her roots; Drummer butts heads with a seasoned new commander aboard the Behemoth; and a young Belter makes a name for himself.
episodes.title: Delta-V

episodes.overview: An old friend taunts Holden with the answers he seeks. Naomi struggles to fit in. A mysterious low-level tech aboard the Thomas Prince enacts a terrifying plan.
episodes.title: It Reaches Out

episodes.overview: The Rocinante seeks a new gameplan as they attempt to avoid capture. Melba's true motives are revealed. Naomi is torn between identity and ideal. Anna seeks a way to stay aboard the Thomas Prince.
episodes.title: Intransigence

episodes.overview: Holden sees past, present, and future. A ghost from Melba's past threatens her mission. Bobbie struggles to trust an old friend as she leads a group into unchartered territory.
episodes.title: Dandelion Sky

episodes.overview: Drummer and Ashford find themselves trapped with few options for survival; Anna tends to the wounded masses as Melba continues to hunt down her prey; the Rocinante crew struggles to survive as Naomi reunites with her true family.
episodes.title: Fallen World

episodes.overview: As survivors arrive at the Behemoth, two factions form over how to handle a life-or-death threat. Holden grapples with what he's seen and the choices he must make.
episodes.title: Congregation

episodes.overview: Holden and his allies must stop Ashford and his team from destroying the Ring, and perhaps all of humanity.
episodes.title: Abaddon's Gate

seasons.overview: As the Rocinante crew digs deeper into the search for Prax's missing daughter, the war between Earth and Mars turns deadly in ways the solar system has never seen. But a new threat in the outer reaches of the Belt could prove much more dangerous, threatening to test the very future of humanity.
seasons.title: Season 3

episodes.overview: The crew of the Roci investigates a strange protomolecule ruin on an alien planet. Bobbie copes with civilian life on Mars. Drummer and Ashford battle with piracy in the Belt.
episodes.title: New Terra

episodes.overview: Avasarala is blindsided while on a visit to Mars. The Roci crew continue their protomolecule investigation while tensions between the RCE and Belters reach a tipping point. Drummer and Ashford track down a terrorist.
episodes.title: Jetsam

episodes.overview: New alien threats emerge on Ilus as Naomi battles health challenges on the planet. Bobbie searches for a missing person on Mars. Avasarala faces a new challenge in the UN.
episodes.title: Subduction

episodes.overview: Drummer and Ashford confront a dangerous person from Naomi's past. Murtry hunts down a target. Bobbie's makes a life-changing confession.
episodes.title: Retrograde

episodes.overview: As tensions on Ilus reach a boiling point, Holden reveals a secret. Avasarala debates Nancy Gao while an emergency on the Roci forces Alex and Naomi into action.
episodes.title: Oppressor

episodes.overview: The Roci crew prepares for an incoming disaster on Ilus. Ashford and Drummer close in on an enemy within the Belt. Bobbie takes on a dangerous job.
episodes.title: Displacement

episodes.title: A Shot in the Dark

episodes.overview: Avasarala faces fallout for the UN's military mission. Ashford and Drummer makes big decisions about their future within the OPA. A spreading illness on Ilus takes a toll on Amos. Alex and Naomi's attempt to rescue the Barb turns desperate.
episodes.title: The One-Eyed Man

episodes.overview: Holden and Miller race to save Ilus. Murtry puts his endgame into motion, putting the Roci crew's lives at risk.
episodes.title: Saeculum

episodes.overview: Ashford closes in on an enemy while uncovering a dangerous plot. Avasarala faces a crossroads in her personal and political life. The Roci crew works to reestablish life on Ilus in the wake of a deadly catastrophe.
episodes.title: Cibola Burn

seasons.overview: With the Ring Gates now open to thousands of new planets, a blood-soaked gold rush begins, igniting new conflicts between Earth, Mars, and the Belt. Meanwhile, on one unexplored planet, the Rocinante crew gets caught in a violent clash between an Earth mining corporation and desperate Belter settlers as deadly, new threats from the protomolecule emerge.
seasons.title: Season 4

episodes.overview: Holden tries to convince Fred Johnson to destroy the last sample of protomolecule. Naomi gets an important lead to her son. On Luna, Avasarala begins to hunt for Marco Inaros.
episodes.title: Exodus

episodes.overview: Holden and Fred deal with infiltrators on Tycho. Drummer's past comes back to haunt her. Amos returns to Baltimore. Alex and Bobbie's investigation on Mars leads to rogue soldiers.
episodes.title: Churn

episodes.overview: Naomi comes face to face with Filip. Holden and Fred turn the tables. Avasarala closes in on Marco's plot.
episodes.title: Mother

episodes.overview: Marco's grand plan shocks Earth, Mars and the Belt.
episodes.title: Gaugamela

episodes.overview: Amos and Clarissa are trapped in a collapsed building. Naomi contends with her old family. Holden assembles a new crew on the Roci. Alex and Bobbie make a dangerous discovery in the Belt.

episodes.overview: Holden and the Roci go on the hunt. Amos and Clarissa seek shelter on a devastated Earth. Bobbie and Alex fight a desperate battle. Marco makes Drummer an offer she can't refuse. Avasarala returns to a position of power.
episodes.title: Tribes

episodes.overview: Naomi makes a desperate attempt to save her son from Marco. On the Roci, Holden battles for the last sample of protomolecule.
episodes.title: Oyedeng

episodes.title: Hard Vacuum

episodes.title: Winnipesaukee

episodes.overview: Holden and the Roci face off against Marco's forces and Drummer, while Alex and Bobbie attempt a dangerous rescue of Naomi, and the balance of power in the Solar System shifts.
episodes.title: Nemesis Games

seasons.overview: In different parts of the Solar System, the crew of the Rocinante and their allies confront the sins of their past, while Marco Inaros unleashes an attack that will alter the future of Earth, Mars, the Belt, and the worlds beyond the Ring.
seasons.title: Season 5

episodes.overview: The Rocinante crew make a startling discovery on an asteroid. Avasarala and Bobbie contend with the devastation on Earth. Drummer and her family must make a heartbreaking decision. On Ceres, Marco and Filip's struggles turn inward.
episodes.title: Strange Dogs

episodes.overview: With an unexpected passenger aboard the Rocinante, Holden and crew undertake a dangerous mission that could shift the balance of power in the war. Drummer decides to make an uneasy alliance. Filip wrestles with his guilt.
episodes.title: Azure Dragon

episodes.overview: Avasarala, with the Combined Fleet of Earth and Mars, takes the war to Marco. Filip and Marco's relationship is tested. The war becomes more perilous and personal for Holden and Naomi when the Rocinante is suddenly forced into a battle.
episodes.title: Force Projection

episodes.overview: Holden finds himself at odds with his crew when a controversial decision is uncovered. On Ceres, Avasarala struggles to contain an escalating humanitarian crisis. Drummer's growing faction stage a daring raid with dire stakes. Filip, demoted to repair skiff duty, makes an unexpected discovery.
episodes.title: Redoubt

episodes.overview: Paths converge on Ceres when Drummer and her fleet arrive to aid the relief effort. Holden tries to convince Avasarala to release crucial information that might avert catastrophe, but she has her own request of him. As Amos and Bobbie get a little R&R at the station, Naomi has a difficult and long-awaited reunion.
episodes.title: Why We Fight

episodes.overview: In the thrilling season finale, Inners and Belters fight side by side with the crew of the Rocinante in a last, massive, desperate battle with Marco and his Free Navy, with the fate of the Solar System, the Ring Gates, and of all humanity hanging in the balance.
episodes.title: Babylon's Ashes

seasons.overview: Holden and the crew of the Rocinante fight alongside the Combined Fleet of Earth and Mars to protect the Inner Planets from Marco Inaros and his Free Navy's campaign of death and destruction. Meanwhile, on a distant planet beyond the Rings, a new power rises.

shows.name: The Masked Singer
shows.overview: Celebrities compete in a singing competition with one major twist: each singer is shrouded from head to toe in an elaborate costume, complete with full face mask to conceal his or her identity. One singer will be eliminated each week, ultimately revealing his or her true identity.

episodes.overview: Celebrity performances from five all-new masked celebrities and a jaw-dropping reveal.
episodes.title: Who Can It Be Now?

episodes.overview: Cut loose with Footloose Night as The Masked Singer celebrates the 40th anniversary of the iconic film! Panelist Robin Thicke opens the evening with a showstopping rendition of Kenny Loggins’ Footloose. The four celebrities from Group A belt out fan-favorite songs from the movie soundtrack.
episodes.title: Footloose Night

episodes.overview: The three Group A Finalists open with a performance of High Hopes by Panic! At The Disco, followed by sensational renditions of songs near and dear to the contestants including Because The Night, Put Your Records On, and Bittersweet Symphony. Two celebrities are unmasked leaving one to move on to the quarter finals.
episodes.title: Group A Finals: Soundtrack of My Life

episodes.overview: Panelists Robin Thicke and Rita Ora open the show with a performance of “Rock You Like A Hurricane” by the Scorpions. The five brand-new contestants make their grand debut with songs like “Rock Your Body,” “Believe,” “We Belong,” “Sweet Caroline,” and “Lose Control.”
episodes.title: Group B Premiere:  Sports Night

episodes.overview: Head inside the Barbie Dream House to learn more about the Group B celebrities as they pay tribute to the 65th anniversary of Mattel's Barbie, celebrating over six decades of breaking down boundaries and inspiring girls to explore their limitless potential.
episodes.title: Barbie Night

episodes.overview: The show opens with a rendition of "Fun, Fun, Fun" by The Beach Boys before the Group B finalists sing to secure a spot in the Quarter Finals. The celebrities pay tribute to the grooviest era of all with songs like, "House Of The Rising Sun," "Do You Love Me," and "Ain't No Way". The show ends with a double elimination unless the judges use the Ding Dong Keep It On Bell.
episodes.title: Group B Finals: '60s Night

episodes.overview: Some familiar faces return to The Masked Singer stage to drop some major clues about their friends' identities. Group C put on show-stopping performances of "You and I," "Under The Bridge," "Tonight Tonight," "Call Me Maybe," and "Slow Burn."
episodes.title: Group C Premiere: Who Are You Fest

episodes.overview: The remaining Group C singers are throwing a "Party In The USA" by opening the show with the iconic hit! Then, the celebrities pay homage to some of Miley's amazing "Bangerz" including, "Used To Be Young," "Midnight Sky," "Wrecking Ball," and "When I Look At You." Who will advance to the Group C finals and who will be unmasked?
episodes.title: Miley Cyrus Night

episodes.overview: It’s the Peanuts Night extravaganza and the whole beloved Peanuts gang is here to celebrate. Nothing says Thanksgiving like A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving, which has served up over 50 years of family fun, traditions and memories! Panelists Rita Ora and Robin Thicke make turkey day dreams come true with their showstopping rendition of “You Make My Dreams Come True.” Then, the Group C finals commence! The celebrities will give Thanksgiving-themed clues and belt out hits like, “I Hope You Dance,” “Holiday,” and “Ho Hey” culminating in a Battle Royale and Double Elimination!
episodes.title: Group C Finals: A Peanuts Thanksgiving

episodes.overview: For the first time, the group champions are all together to battle it out and share some pivotal clues. The celebrities turn up the heat with performances to songs like, “Standing Next To You,” “Iris,” “Closer,” and “You’re Still The One.”
episodes.title: Quarter Finals: Merging of the Masks

episodes.overview: The semi-finalists open the show with a spectacular performance of “Some Nights.” Then, the celebrities pull out all the stops in renditions of “Lose You To Love Me,” “Africa,” and “Beautiful Things.” For the first time ever, the Battle Royale and Smackdown is fusing into the “Smack Royale.” Additionally, clues are given in the form of friendship bracelets, gifted to a panelist each celebrity is friends with!
episodes.title: Semi-Finals: The Final Three

episodes.overview: Season 5 winner, Piglet (Nick Lachey), returns to the stage to ring in the Holiday season with a joyful rendition of “It’s The Most Wonderful Time Of The Year” while the panel cozy up with each other for the most exciting finale ever. The final two pull out all the stops for the most coveted award in all of entertainment, The Golden Mask Trophy! They bring the house down with showstopping performances of “When I Was Your Man,” “Somebody That I Used To Know,” “I’m Your Baby Tonight,” and “Too Good At Goodbyes.”
episodes.title: Finale: A Champion Is Crowned

episodes.overview: Contestants from Group A perform hits like "SexyBack," "Just Give Me a Reason," "The Door," "La Bamba" and "Mad World."
episodes.title: Lucky Season 13: Group A Premiere

episodes.overview: Group A channels their inner fairytale by performing songs from or inspired by the "Shrek" movie franchise.
episodes.title: Shrek Night

episodes.overview: It's "Rat Pack Night" on The Masked Singer! Get ready for The Masked Singer's resident crooner, Robin Thicke, to Fly You To The Moon when he opens the show with the classic alongside Group A's Ant, Paparazzo and Coral. This evening's tribute to the Rat Pack has even more action than a Vegas casino! Group A will swoon, sing and serenade the audience with some of the Rat Pack's most iconic classics including, "Luck Be A Lady," "Fever," "That's Amore" and "My Way!"
episodes.title: Group A Finals: A Rat Pack Tribute Night

episodes.overview: Five new masks appear as the Voices of Olympus; contestants perform showstopping renditions of "I Believe In a Thing Called Love," "Bad Blood," "Rewrite the Stars," "Espresso" and "Saving All My Love For You."
episodes.title: Group B Premiere: Voices of Olympus

episodes.overview: The panelists transform into ghost busting detectives along with an iconic visit from an original Ghostbuster, Ernie Hudson! Group B ain't afraid of no ghosts! They bring the house down with amazing performances of "(Don't Fear) The Reaper," "Disturbia," "Cleanin' Up The Town," and "Radioactive" before one celebrity must reveal themselves.
episodes.title: Ghostbusters Night

episodes.overview: The Group B finalists perform "Save a Horse (Ride a Cowboy), and renditions of "Here You Come Again," "Take Me Home, Country Roads" and "Something in the Water."
episodes.title: Group B Finals: Grand Ole Opry Night

episodes.overview: The celebrities deliver astounding performances of "Hot To Go," "Jump Around," "Roxanne," "Let's Get Loud," and "Unwell" before one celebrity must reveal themselves.
episodes.title: Group C Premiere: Carnival Night

episodes.overview: Paying tribute to boy bands; contestants perform iconic boy band classics like "Tearin' Up My Heart," "Poison," "Step By Step," and "I Swear."
episodes.title: Boy Band Night

episodes.overview: Group C opens the show with a rockstar performance of "My Sharona" before the celebrities bring the house down with renditions of "Stop! In The Name Of Love," "Love Yourself," "Can't Fight This Feeling," and "Hard to Handle." One celebrity automatically advances to the Lucky Six while two battle it out in an electrifying Battle Royale to see who moves along to the Lucky Six and who must reveal themselves.
episodes.title: Group C Finals: Decades Night

episodes.overview: It's time for a "Merging Of The Masks" for the Lucky 6 on The Masked Singer! The final six celebrities in the competition are ready to battle it out to get one step closer to the illusive Golden Mask Trophy and this week, the panelists will have an opportunity to ask some rapid-fire questions to each masked contestant.
episodes.title: The Lucky 6: Merging of the Masks

episodes.overview: It's "Soundtrack Of My Life Night!" The top five have come to play and open the show with a pitch-perfect performance of "More Than A Feeling." Then, the masks will be singing songs with a special meaning to them and we will get to hear from those closest to them.
episodes.title: Quarter Finals: Soundtrack of My Life Night

episodes.overview: It's the Semi Finals on The Masked Singer and the final four are ready to make some hands clap with their superstar rendition of "HandClap!" The four semi-finalists are ready to battle it out ahead of next week's blockbuster season finale.
episodes.title: The Semi-Finals: Head-To-Head Battles

episodes.overview: In the grand culmination of Lucky Season 13, it is time for the final four to battle it out to be crowned the Season 13 Winner of The Masked Singer!
episodes.title: The Two-Hour Lucky Season 13 Finale

episodes.overview: A strange noblewoman arrives in a remote mountain village, claiming one of five youths is the reincarnation of an ancient power who once destroyed the world – and will do so again, if she’s not able to discover which of them it is. But they all have less time than they think.

shows.name: The White Lotus
shows.overview: Follow the exploits of various guests and employees at an exclusive tropical resort over the span of a week as with each passing day, a darker complexity emerges in these picture-perfect travelers, the hotel’s cheerful employees and the idyllic locale itself.

episodes.overview: As a new wave of guests arrive at the White Lotus, resort manager Armond tries to assuage an unreasonable Shane and his easy-going new wife Rachel, while spa director Belinda calms a grieving Tanya. Meanwhile, Nicole suggests her husband Mark distract himself from a health scare by spending time with their son Quinn, who’s been cast out by his sister Olivia and her friend Paula.
episodes.title: Arrivals

episodes.overview: A cautiously optimistic Belinda walks a fine line with Tanya, while Armond brainstorms ways to deal with Shane. After her husband belittles her work, Rachel approaches Nicole for advice. Paula and Olivia lose track of their stash, while a revived Mark attempts to connect with Quinn.

episodes.overview: Stripped of his gadgets, Quinn reluctantly takes a scuba class with Mark, who’s struggling to process revelations regarding his late father. Hoping to reignite the spark with Rachel, Shane enlists Armond to help plan a romantic evening. Tanya leans on Belinda for support as she scatters her mother’s ashes at sea. Paula keeps a secret from a suspicious Olivia.
episodes.title: Mysterious Monkeys

episodes.overview: After Shane shoots down her latest career plans, Rachel is further blindsided by an unexpected arrival. Just as Belinda begins to take her business proposition seriously, Tanya’s attention turns to an intriguing hotel guest. Meanwhile, Armond’s renewed commitment to sobriety is put to the test.
episodes.title: Recentering

episodes.overview: As Armond attempts to do damage control, Belinda tries to redirect Tanya’s focus to her business proposal. Paula grows increasingly disillusioned with the Mossbachers. A sidelined Rachel begins to question her future. Nicole rebuffs Mark for airing their dirty laundry to Quinn.
episodes.title: The Lotus-Eaters

episodes.overview: Rachel shares some harsh truths with Shane and confides in Belinda, who’s reeling from bad news of her own. As the Mossbachers turn the page on their harrowing scare, Quinn reveals major life plans. With nothing left to lose, Armond goes on an all-out bender – and exacts the ultimate revenge on his nemesis.

shows.name: Upload
shows.overview: In 2033, people who are near death can be “uploaded” into virtual reality hotels run by 6 tech firms. Cash-strapped Nora lives in Brooklyn and works customer service for the luxurious “Lakeview” digital afterlife. When L.A. party-boy/coder Nathan’s self-driving car crashes, his high-maintenance girlfriend uploads him permanently into Nora’s VR world.

episodes.overview: After a self-driving car crash, Nathan is uploaded to Lakeview, his girlfriend’s family’s digital after-life, where he meets his customer service rep, Nora.

shows.name: Yellowjackets
shows.overview: This equal parts survival epic, psychological horror story and coming-of-age drama tells the saga of a team of wildly talented high school girls soccer players who become the (un)lucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the remote northern wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to savage clans, while also tracking the lives they’ve attempted to piece back together nearly 25 years later.

seasons.overview: A thriving high school girls soccer squad is left stranded in the northern wilderness after a plane crash and descend into savage clans, where survival becomes even more important than the team.
seasons.title: Season 1

episodes.overview: Two months into winter the survivors cope with falling rations, low morale and their latest disastrous attempt to freeze a teammate out of the game. Shauna explores the secondary market for Yellowjackets memorabilia, while Taissa, Misty and Natalie all seek out best friends, both old and new. For those of you keeping the stat book: Lottie Matthews comes in off the bench.
episodes.title: Friends, Romans, Countrymen

episodes.overview: The Yellowjackets barely made it through summer in the woods, but now as winter begins to bite, we’ll see if hunger and desperation turn into full-on psychosis. While there may or may not be a dark and powerful force inhabiting the wilderness, their survival could depend upon what they choose to believe. Meanwhile, twenty-five years later, each survivor must ask themselves – Is the darkness coming for them, or is it coming from them?
episodes.title: Edible Complex

episodes.overview: The girls experience an unusual hangover. Shauna learns the thrill of peer-to-peer car rentals. Natalie audits Lottie’s class in emotional apiology. Tai reflects, Misty hits the high seas, and you’ve never attended a baby shower like the one the Yellowjackets throw here.
episodes.title: Digestif

episodes.overview: Relive your youth by hitting the road! Take a roadtrip with your child! Go on vacation with a new friend! Hitchhike, if you must! Just make sure you pack a good playlist for the ride. Some recommendations from us: “Anything You Can Do,” “You Get What You Give,” “Instinct,” a famous composition by Frank Comstock, but absolutely not anything from “Starlight Express”.
episodes.title: Old Wounds

episodes.overview: Okay, Fellowjackets, rise and shine and don’t forget your booties because it’s coooold out there. Misty makes a leap of faith for her bestie, Natalie and Lottie play a game of surrender, Shauna finds herself unexpectedly randy, and Tai seeks out a movie recommendation.
episodes.title: Two Truths and a Lie

episodes.overview: Trapped inside on a snow day, the Yellowjackets revisit the highlights, humiliations and traumas of “Health Class.” Tai and Van help each other kindly rewind, Misty explores joining a classic Cosmic American tribute band, Lisa helps Natalie carp the day, and Shauna gets a pop-quiz on her cookie-reading assignment.
episodes.title: Qui

episodes.overview: Sometimes the best therapy is cranking the hits to eleven, so today we’re exploring the hardcore kid-care revival movement, 11 o’clock theatrical birdcore numbers, some late hits of the renovationwave era (call us about a spinoff!), flower duets, and a classic live record. Out in the wilderness, Coach Scott does a great Karl Havoc impression for an unimpressed Misty.
episodes.title: Burial

episodes.overview: Shhh, it’s only going to get worse from here. Despite the whole “winter never’s gonna end” thing, the 1996 New Jersey state girls soccer champions decide to start their spring training early with an impromptu cardio session. Callie encounters an old flame, Van proves goalies never say die, most of the adults intentionally commune in the sharing shack, and, Lottie, baby, I hear the blues are calling for tossed salad and scrambled eggs. Mercy!
episodes.title: It Chooses

episodes.overview: Heavy is the head that wears the antler crown is a lesson you don’t learn until much later in life… if you ever even learn it at all. Everything’s about to get really wild(erness), and we’re so excited (so excited!) and so, so scared to find out who paid attention to what lessons and when. So, on the count of three, you may pick up your pencil, open your testing booklet, and start this finale exam. One… Two…

Meanwhile, twenty-five years later, each survivor must ask themselves—is the darkness coming for them, or is it coming from them?

episodes.overview: Summer inspires the Yellowjackets to ditch soccer for a more contact-intensive sport and revive an old pagan tradition. In the present, a cringe-worthy funeral flows organically into a bar therapy session.
episodes.title: It Girl

episodes.overview: The Yellowjackets are stuck deciding whether to track down a missing teammate or just trip out on mushrooms. Shauna secures a spot on the world's most unsupportive partner list. Misty finds herself tangled in the intimate chaos of sleepover parties.
episodes.title: Dislocation

episodes.overview: The return of a Yellowjacket sparks a vengeful frenzy in the team. Lottie's rendition of Cool Aunt Without Kids leaves Callie with an open door to answers about her mother's twisted past. Tai and Van receive a karmic payout for their dine and dash.
episodes.title: Them's the Brakes

episodes.overview: The Yellowjackets attempt to spin a hundred suspicions into proof. Coach Scott has an existential meltdown. Meanwhile, Jeff embarks on a crusade to make things right as Shauna is forcibly committed to some "me time." Spoiler: it's not a spa day.
episodes.title: 12 Angry Girls and 1 Drunk Travis

episodes.overview: The Yellowjackets confront the reality of having to pull an Old Yeller. Lottie mentors an up-and-coming prophet. In the present, Misty investigates a suspicious death. Shauna, desperate, turns to the last person she would trust – because, why not?
episodes.title: Did Tai Do That?

episodes.overview: The Yellowjackets start turning on each other faster than a reality TV reunion special. Meanwhile, the Sadecki family "vacation" features a vending machine and a deep dive into questionable parenting choices. Misty uncovers an incriminating clue.
episodes.title: Thanksgiving (Canada)

episodes.overview: The Yellowjackets realize their choices have snowballed into a catastrophe. Misty sets her sights on a fresh suspect, and even she's surprised by the plot twist. Meanwhile, Taissa's desperation is peeling back layers she didn't even know she had.
episodes.title: Croak

episodes.overview: With a possible escape from their nightmare, the Yellowjackets learn not everyone may be in a rush to leave. In the present, the unexpected return of an old teammate sends Shauna spiraling in ways that should probably concern everyone.
episodes.title: A Normal, Boring Life

episodes.overview: The Yellowjackets' rites of spring come to an end, with Misty getting a pick-me-up and Shauna facing a sticky Melissa problem, all while taking cues from Stravinsky (or Picciotto).
episodes.title: How the Story Ends

episodes.overview: Things turn frigid as bloody new alliances get built and spilled. It's our time, right now, down here in the new Queen's court. Eat up, drink deep, and descend.
episodes.title: Full Circle

seasons.overview: In season three, as summer arrives, the Yellowjackets face a fragile victory—the brutal winter that nearly claimed them is finally behind them, but distrust in leadership and tension within the team jeopardize their chances of being rescued. In the present, long-buried secrets from their pasts begin to surface. As the women fight to keep their lives from unraveling, they must confront a chilling question: who are they really, and what dark truths are they hiding from each other and themselves?
seasons.title: Season 3

And when some lifeless corpses are found in a birch grove near Smolensk... their peaceful life falls under threat.

shows.name: You
shows.overview: A dangerously charming, intensely obsessive young man goes to extreme measures to insert himself into the lives of those he is transfixed by.

episodes.overview: A charming first encounter quickly turns into something more nefarious when bookstore manager Joe takes a very strong liking to grad student Beck.

episodes.overview: As Beck deals with unwanted advances from her advisor, she brings Joe to Peach’s high society soiree. Joe tries to navigate matters with Benji.

episodes.overview: Beck’s continued casual encounters catch Joe off guard, as does a run-in with the police. Both make him realize a key situation must be dealt with.
episodes.title: Maybe

episodes.overview: After an awkward evening with Beck, Joe discovers he’s not the only one keeping secrets. Peach’s antagonistic approach to Joe intensifies.
episodes.title: The Captain

episodes.overview: A video from Annika’s past comes back to haunt her. Joe and Peach’s simmering tension boils over when Peach introduces Beck to a major literary agent.
episodes.title: Living with the Enemy

episodes.overview: Beck heads to Connecticut with Peach, whose motives are not what they seem. Joe’s pursuit of her stirs up old memories – and brings new injuries.

episodes.overview: A grieving Beck turns to therapy, which leads Joe to do the same – for different reasons. Joe’s plans for Beck’s birthday don’t go as expected.
episodes.title: Everythingship

episodes.overview: Three months later, life is good for Joe and Beck, respectively. But a series of reconnections may spell trouble for Joe’s current relationship.

episodes.overview: So, what exactly happened to Candace? Beck is determined to find out – but to do so, she'll have to take a page straight from Joe's book.

episodes.overview: Joe juggles problems with Paco and Beck – and now must contend with a private investigator as well. But resolution is coming, one way or another.
episodes.title: Bluebeard's Castle

seasons.overview: Obsessed with an aspiring writer, a brilliant bookstore manager begins quietly and strategically removing all obstacles that keep her from him.
seasons.title: Season 1

episodes.overview: Joe – now “Will” – arrives in his own personal hell on Earth: LA. He's trying to go straight, but the past doesn’t always leave well enough alone.

episodes.overview: Joe realizes Will Bettelheim isn’t all he’s cracked up to be. The fallout threatens to get in the way of his burgeoning connection with Love.

episodes.overview: Joe attempts to keep things platonic with Love and keep his nose out of Ellie's business. But his instincts soon get the better of him.

episodes.overview: As he tries to adapt to sharing Love with Forty, Joe is caught off guard by a group date – while his protectiveness of Ellie quickly escalates.

episodes.overview: Love brings Joe to a wellness weekend, where he gets a good look at her family's dynamic. But Forty’s surprise guest has him feeling anything but zen.
episodes.title: Have a Good Wellkend, Joe!

episodes.overview: Joe performs surveillance on a potential problem, but suspects someone might be tailing him, too. Painful memories put Love on edge about the present.
episodes.title: Farewell, My Bunny

episodes.overview: To soothe heartache, Joe turns to ancient remedies, modern technology and drinking with Delilah. But one small slip-up could have major consequences.
episodes.title: Ex-istential Crisis

episodes.overview: Joe wants to get away, but Forty insists they finish their script. As pressure mounts, Forty’s excessive coping devices make for a harrowing night.

episodes.overview: As Love looks after an increasingly skittish Ellie, Joe tries to reconstruct the events of a trippy evening – but finds the truth to be elusive.
episodes.title: P.I. Joe

episodes.overview: Joe has always been full of surprises, but Love has a few of her own. Is this the beginning of the end, or the end of the deceiving?

seasons.overview: Meet Will Bettelheim. He’s not your regular Joe. He’s new to LA and has sworn off love. But love, like murder, has a way of tracking you down.
seasons.title: Season 2

episodes.overview: After a delivery room surprise, new dad Joe struggles to connect with his infant child, but he has no trouble at all fostering a new infatuation.
episodes.title: And They Lived Happily Ever After

episodes.overview: Joe and Love try couples therapy, but their issues may need more than counseling – and their friction isn't the only thing they need to make disappear.
episodes.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer

episodes.overview: Love grows apprehensive as media scrutiny intensifies next door. An acute sickness in the family drudges up old memories – and worse – for Joe.
episodes.title: Missing White Woman Syndrome

episodes.overview: An impulsive retaliation by Love lands her and Joe in a bind. Though Joe seeks a different way out than usual, it proves to be a tall order.
episodes.title: Hands Across Madre Linda

episodes.overview: Joe begrudgingly goes on a hunting trip with some other local husbands as Love tries to manage her burgeoning relationship with Theo.
episodes.title: Into the Woods

episodes.overview: As her mother launches a new venture, Love grows increasingly concerned about a potential big change herself. Joe has a breakthrough in self-awareness.
episodes.title: W.O.M.B.

episodes.overview: While Dottie spirals into emotional turmoil, Love tries to get intel on Matthew's investigation. Joe sets his sights on derailing Marienne's ex.

episodes.overview: Joe selfishly tries to coerce Love into a lifestyle change, but things go south quickly. Theo discovers just how deep Matthew's obsession goes.

episodes.overview: While Love tends to some unexpected long-term guests, Joe decides to take a drastic step to get what he wants the most.

episodes.overview: As news permeates the community about a recent murder, Joe looks toward a future with Marienne – but hell hath no fury like Love scorned.

seasons.overview: Now married with a young baby, Love and Joe try to forge a normal life in the affluent suburb of Madre Linda. But old habits die hard.

episodes.overview: Now living in London, Joe tries to lay low and resist old habits... until he's forced to tie up loose ends and bond with a circle of wealthy socialites.
episodes.title: Joe Takes a Holiday

episodes.overview: Joe leans on his skills — and a student's insights — to catch his stalker. An art show offers a gallery of suspects, revealing more than the eye can see.

episodes.overview: As news of a killer targeting the rich swirls, Joe's stalker inches dangerously close to the truth. Joe's efforts to protect Kate take a dark turn.

episodes.overview: A ritzy weekend getaway doubles as a chance for Joe to hunt down his elusive stalker. Without cell service or Wi-Fi, Joe makes a key connection.
episodes.title: Hampsie

episodes.overview: While falling back into familiar patterns, Joe gets caught up in an unfortunate game as everyone's plans go up in flames.
episodes.title: The Fox and the Hound

episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the murders, Joe searches for a scapegoat and Rhys pursues his grand ambitions while Kate and Phoebe assert their independence.
episodes.title: Best of Friends

episodes.overview: The tables turn for Joe when an influential figure comes to town with a tempting offer as Nadia follows a hunch.
episodes.title: Good Man, Cruel World

episodes.overview: As memories of the past trickle in, Joe struggles to recall an important detail. Phoebe shares her hasty plans with Kate. Nadia scrambles for a solution.
episodes.title: Where Are You Going, Where Have You Been?

episodes.overview: Torn between his dark side and good intentions, Joe works to right his wrongs. After attempting to help Phoebe, Kate faces her father – and hard truths.
episodes.title: She's Not There

episodes.overview: With love and loss weighing heavily on his mind, Joe commits a final act in hopes of never walking down the same path again.
episodes.title: The Death of Jonathan Moore

seasons.overview: Starting anew in London, Joe vows to bury the past and be his best self. But on the rocky road to redemption, a new obsession starts to take hold.

episodes.overview: Joe and Kate settle in New York with a pledge to start over, but their headline-making marriage hits a snag when betrayal strikes close to home.
episodes.title: The Luckiest Guy in NY

episodes.overview: A family dinner descends into chaos when Kate's sister Reagan makes a shocking allegation. Bronte's curiosity lands her in a tight spot.
episodes.title: Blood Will Have Blood

episodes.overview: Joe hits an impasse in Mooney's basement, as tension builds at home. Kate plays hardball to protect Henry. Bronte faces exposure at a literary salon.

episodes.overview: A game-changing announcement at Lockwood Corporation sets off alarm bells for Kate. An unwelcome guest crashes Mooney's grand reopening.
episodes.title: My Fair Maddie

episodes.overview: Fueled by fear, Kate finds answers from a troubled source. A puzzling note at work sends Joe on a search for the whereabouts of a missing person.
episodes.title: Last Dance

episodes.overview: A viral video complicates Joe's dreams of a fresh start — and forces Bronte to question her loyalties. Kate makes changes at home.
episodes.title: The Dark Face of Love

episodes.overview: As faces from his past resurface, the "most visible man in New York" must sway the court of public opinion.

episodes.overview: Hoping to decisively close the book on the past, Joe embarks on a risky new chapter. But as with every great story, one last twist awaits.

shows.name: The Inspector Lynley Mysteries
shows.overview: DS Barbara Havers is assigned to work with the upper-crust DI Thomas Lynley to solve murders.

episodes.overview: In the remote Yorkshire moors, a farmer's decapitated body is discovered in a field. DS Barbara Havers is partnered with Inspector Lynley to investigate the brutal murder.
episodes.title: A Great Deliverance (1)

episodes.overview: Inspector Lynley and DS Havers continue their investigation into the Yorkshire farmhouse murder.
episodes.title: A Great Deliverance (2)

episodes.overview: Detective Inspector Lynley and Detective Sergeant Havers are drawn into the closed world of prestigious public school Bredgar Hall when a promising young pupil, Matthew Whateley, goes missing.
episodes.title: Well-Schooled in Murder

episodes.overview: Lynley and Havers travel to the Highlands of Scotland, where an eminent playwright has been murdered. The suspects are glamorous stars of the film and theatre world, who have been rehearsing their new play in impresario Sir Stuart Stinhurst's remote country pile.
episodes.title: Payment in Blood

episodes.overview: In the rarefied world of Cambridge, Lynley and Havers investigate the murder of Elena Weaver – a stunning young deaf student, bludgeoned to death on a morning run. When it emerges that she was pregnant, Elena's life seems to have been a mystery to even those closest to her.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Elena

episodes.overview: In an apparently tranquil Lancashire village, Lynley investigates the mysterious poisoning of vicar Robin Sage.
episodes.title: Missing Joseph

episodes.overview: While investigating the death of star cricketer Kenneth Waring with DS Havers, DI Lynley delves into his complex personal life and is forced to break the rules.
episodes.title: Playing for the Ashes

episodes.overview: The relationship between Lynley and Havers reaches its all-time low when they investigate a case of kidnapping and murder involving the secret child of a member of parliament and a newspaper editor.
episodes.title: In the Presence of the Enemy

episodes.overview: Lynley returns to his ancestral home in Cornwall to celebrate his engagement to Helen. His difficult relationship with his dysfunctional family is soon overshadowed by a murder on part of his own estate - and the chief suspect is Peter, Lynley's drug-addict brother.
episodes.title: A Suitable Vengeance

episodes.overview: The body of a young Asian man is found on the beach at the seaside town of Balford-le-Nez, leading the police into a web of racial tensions, family loyalties and illicit sexuality in investigating the murder. Havers has time on her hands while Lynley is on honeymoon in Peru, and when she finds the Balford-le-Nez investigation is being run by a friend she joins the hunt.
episodes.title: Deception on His Mind

episodes.overview: Two dead bodies are found in the middle of a stone circle. One of them was the daughter of a retired police officer who lives in a nearby village, while the other was a local artist. There is at first no clear connection between the two, but Havers finds an important clue which leads Lynley to the killer.
episodes.title: In Pursuit of the Proper Sinner

episodes.overview: A famous violinist appearing at the Wigmore Hall, London, suddenly can't play any more, and away from the city centre a lonely woman is killed in a hit and run accident. Lynley and Havers try to find the connection between the musician and the death. To get at the truth, they need to dig deep into the past and also to put their careers on the line.
episodes.title: A Traitor to Memory

episodes.overview: A woman is found dead, and it looks as if she committed suicide. But Havers has doubts. The police investigation leads Lynley to a private club, while Havers goes undercover. The true motive for the death affects Lynley deeply.
episodes.title: A Cry for Justice

episodes.overview: Lynley and Havers investigate the murder of Professor Dermot Finnegan, an old friend and mentor of Helen's who has been killed by a car bomb. Helen, who is pregnant, is later attacked in her car, and on admission to hospital her baby is found to have died. Havers searches Finnegan's office and finds love letters from several women - including one from Helen. She suggests that Lynley should be taken off the case, but he is determined to go on with it for the sake of Helen. In the end, Lynley has a shocking confrontation with the killer.
episodes.title: If Wishes Were Horses

episodes.overview: Havers gets back to work after being shot and is assigned to a case in rural Suffolk, where a young woman has been murdered with a shot gun. Lynley is worried about the effect the case will have on Havers. Then a photograph of the murdered woman arguing with a man is sent to the police, and a mysterious word is painted on the wall of the crime scene - it seems as if someone is trying to give the team some clues. As a result, they uncover a dark secret that villagers have kept quiet for years. In a final confrontation, Havers has to face down her fear of being back in the line of fire.
episodes.title: In Divine Proportion

episodes.overview: Havers is on holiday in Cornwall, learning Akido, and Lynley is also in the county to visit his mother, when a local horse trainer is found hanged in a stable on the estate next to Lynley's. The dead man's money troubles suggest suicide, but then Lynley finds he had links with smuggling. Another lead suggests that the killer may be uncomfortably close to home. As the case develops, Lynley has to think out where his future lies - with the police, or managing his own property?
episodes.title: In the Guise of Death

episodes.overview: Lynley and Havers investigate the killing of a porter at the House of Lords. At first it looks as if the murder may be connected to the dead man's gambling debts, but then a senior clerk is also murdered, with evidence of a conspiracy involving stolen test reports on a new missile system. Havers traces the missing documents, but then she finds she and Lynley are both being followed...
episodes.title: The Seed of Cunning

episodes.overview: The frozen body of a man is found on a meat truck in London's Smithfield Market, and on the body are a forged British passport and an Arabic manuscript on a page of vellum. The dead man appears to be an illegal immigrant - but was his death accidental? The manuscript turns out to be a page of an ancient Koran, hugely valuable. And Lynley finds himself locking horns with Inspector Brennan, of the Metropolitan Police's immigration department...
episodes.title: The Word of God

episodes.overview: Since Lynley's arrest and suspension for threatening a suspect, Havers has been without a partner. She begins a new case in Kent alongside the heavily pregnant, no-nonsense Detective Inspector Fiona Knight. Together, they investigate the murder of Edie Covington, whose body has been discovered in a local lake.
episodes.title: Natural Causes

episodes.overview: When a key witness is murdered, Lynley and Havers find their case against violent criminal Michael Shand crumbling around them.
episodes.title: One Guilty Deed

episodes.overview: When aspiring lawyer Emily Proctor is found axed to death in Hyde Park, Lynley and Havers are drawn to the chambers of human rights lawyer Tony Wainwright and his clerk Hester Reed. Wainwright's passionate temper and a concealed affair with the victim seem to place him as the main suspect, but when Emily's double life is exposed, Lynley and Havers enter a world of internet porn and a family haunted by secrets.
episodes.title: Chinese Walls

episodes.overview: When former war photographer Peter Rooker is shot, a murder trail from tabloid newspaper mogul Eddie Price and editor Melissa Booth is traced back to a family executed by the Serbian militia in Bosnia. When Lynley asks his wife Helen to assist him with unlocking the psychological history behind the killing, he sets in motion a tragic trail of events.
episodes.title: In the Blink of an Eye

episodes.overview: Old wounds are reopened when Lynley investigates the disturbing death of his godson more than a decade after the boy's disappearance. Lynley is drawn into the case, leading him first to Rome and then headlong into the middle of a new murder enquiry in which Lynley himself becomes the prime suspect. Will Havers be able to save his skin?
episodes.title: Limbo

episodes.overview: Lynley and Havers's friendship is pushed to its limits in a high profile and chilling investigation into the disappearance of two teenage girls. Can Lynley save the life of the second victim and pin a murder charge on his suspects?
episodes.title: Know Thine Enemy
